description: Lists closing days for one calendar and year (2000-2099): NYSE full closures and 1 pm early closes, Federal Reserve (Fedwire/FedACH) holidays with Saturday/Sunday observance rules, TARGET2 closing days, UK England & Wales bank holidays with substitute days. Weekend-only holidays with no weekday closure are omitted. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.
name: list_holidays
title: Holidays (and NYSE early closes) for a calendar and year
